bayts.text: Triumphant are those who have kept the fast of a month in which the gate of torment has been shut.
They shall see the most excellent breaking of the fast in the graves and at the Resurrection, from the Enricher, the Great.
The Creator of creatures has borne witness to His good pleasure for those who fast in Ramaḍān and keep vigil in prayer.
Their gifts with God are abundant: they have obtained their aspirations in the degrees of the Hereafter.
The punishment of the Fire has been turned toward others than them, without dirham or dinar.
The Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ) has raised them through Ramaḍān; the Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ) has benefited them through the prayers.
The Everlasting (Al-Bāqī) has extended to them the aspirations of souls, Lord of the seven earths and the layered heavens (Qurʾān 67:3).
The hospitality of the Everlasting in the Gardens effaces the toil of fasting with munificence.
The reward of Him with Whom what He holds is never exhausted is a great reward, which exhaustion has never touched.
The benefit of the month's fast, in the two Abodes, spares you the two disgraces and the two fires.
You have worshipped Allah, the Generous, the Most Generous, in the best of months, which leads to generosity.
Toward others than you the fires turn, on the Day of Resurrection, and likewise perdition.
You have mastered the souls during the day: toward others than you turn those who rebuke harshly.
The gates of the Gardens of Bliss have been opened for those who fast, and all have swung wide.
For you, at the breaking of the fast and at the meeting (with the Lord), O my people, (there are) two joys, with elevation.
You shall know that your Lord is Generous, and that with Him are rewards that never cease.
You have thanked Allah for the month of fasting: you shall enter a Garden without torment.
